extracted.intended_audience: aspiring stand-up comedians and comedy students
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for aspiring stand-up comedians on writing and performing material, developing a comic persona/voice, and managing the business and career aspects of stand-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master the Techniques of Stand-Up Comedy Performing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to produce onstage emotions that give life to performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create this emotional life night after night. Present it in a way that seems spontaneous and unrehearsed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create Your Comic Persona
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be as individual as your real-life personality, only more so. The persona is the lens through which all material works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master the Techniques of Stand-Up Comedy Writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop strong joke construction and the ability to refine and edit material for clarity, timing, and payoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop a Strong Comic Voice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have a worldview the audience can identify quickly; voice should make material feel cohesive and distinctive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop Original Material
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid obvious topics handled by others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find the angle no one else has; originality of perspective and approach is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand the Business
rubrics_metrics.description: Need to be knowledgeable about the comedy business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Know clubs, bookings, agents, contracts and other practical/industry aspects necessary to sustain a career.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have Fun
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand-up is the one endeavor where having fun is actually a requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The audience reads enjoyment; the performer should convey genuine enjoyment onstage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handle hecklers
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop strategies to manage audience interruptions and maintain control of the set; listed as an implied essential skill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refine material through performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use live performances to test, iterate, and polish jokes and timing; the book emphasizes learning from stage time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Network
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build relationships with peers, bookers, and industry people to create opportunities and learn the business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop multiple sets
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have material for different time lengths and contexts (short spots, longer sets) so you can work varied gigs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build a brand
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate a coherent public identity across gigs and marketing so audiences and industry remember you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage stage fright
rubrics_metrics.description: Implied to-do list item (not fully recovered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop techniques to handle nerves so performance quality is consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is there a clear comic persona?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an evaluative checkpoint: clarity and distinctiveness of onstage persona as a primary criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the material feel original to this comedian?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether jokes and perspectives feel authentic and unique to the performer rather than generic or derivative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are the techniques (writing AND performing) on display?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks for evidence of crafted joke construction and effective stage delivery (timing, emotion, presence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the comedian seem to enjoy themselves?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates visible enjoyment and the ability to convey fun to the audience; audience reads enjoyment as part of success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Could the audience describe the comedian's worldview?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether the performer’s point of view/worldview is clear enough that audiences can articulate it after the set.
